ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_rankgap_exp_weighted
ir.intuition: Instead of modeling raw log probability margins, this loss applies a rank-based exponential weighting on the advantage gap combined with a contrastive hinge on log probabilities, encouraging sharper separation aligned with rank signals while weighting pairs exponentially by rank difference magnitude. This paradigm uses a rank_gap signal and exponential weighting for emphasis.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_exp = exp(rank_gap)
gap = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
margin_loss = relu(margin_val - gap)
weighted_loss = margin_loss * rank_exp * weight
final_loss = mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    rank_gap = batch['delta_rank']
    margin_val = float(extra.get('margin_val', 1.0))

    rank_exp = ops.exp(rank_gap)
    gap = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_raw = ops.sub(margin_val, gap)
    margin = ops.relu(margin_raw)

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(margin, ops.mul(rank_exp, weight))
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
